name: EPIC 206084717
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 9.7 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206084717 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.709288 (16th-84th percentiles 9.447327-10.088766), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206084717: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4602.286 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206084717 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1659.511719 (16th-84th percentiles 1623.359375-1705), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.06 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,660 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.88 solar masses and 9.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,602 K at its surface.
